chains.name: Uranium & nuclear fuel cycle
chains.thesis: Reactor restarts, life extensions, new builds and datacenter-driven nuclear PPAs collide with a decade of mine under-investment; the term-contracting cycle reprices the whole fuel chain — miners, converters, enrichers, fuel services — years before spot moves show it.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (UxC/Numerco via press) or SRUUF/U.UN trust NAV proxy — uranium spot is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The one chain where the contracting cycle (term vs spot) is the regime tell. UROY is the royalty pure-play (business_model=royalty_streamer, auto-passes cash gates). Restart/greenfield developers (NXE, DNN-class) are lane_b via dated milestones (permits, FID, first drum).

chains.name: Copper & industrial-metal producers
chains.thesis: Grid build-out, datacenters, EVs and reshored manufacturing add structural copper demand into a thin project pipeline — new mines take 10+ years from discovery to first cathode; the cost curve reprices producers long before the deficit closes.

commodity.spot_source: FMP commodities (COMEX HG front month) — feed-verified 2026-07-27

chains.notes: The PRODUCER/ROYALTY half of v1.3's copper_electrification. 'Copper' is PROVEN live (SCCO, FCX); 'Aluminum' stays unverified (no member confirmed yet) so it sits in fmp_industries_verify. SPLIT RULE: business_model producer|royalty_streamer belongs here; equipment_services|utility belongs to fdt:electrification_grid and is a mapping error if it maps here (printed + dropped). Diversified miners (TECK-class) may carry copper_mining + diversified_miners — legal 2-chain WITHIN this book.

chains.name: Precious metals — producers & royalties
chains.thesis: A monetary-debasement and central-bank-bid regime meets a decade of reserve depletion and falling grades: producers gear FCF to the gold/silver price, royalty/streamers gear to it without carrying the capex. The cycle question is whether all-in cost inflation is eating the metal move — margin, not the metal, is the thesis.

commodity.spot_source: FMP commodities (COMEX GC + SI front month) — both feed-verified 2026-07-27

chains.notes: ALL THREE industry strings PROVEN live 2026-07-27: Gold (AEM/NEM/WPM/FNV/RGLD), Silver (PAAS/AG), Other Precious Metals (HL). WPM/FNV/RGLD map business_model=royalty_streamer and auto-pass the Lane A cash/profit gates (existing bypass) but NEVER the forensic gate. MONETARY_METAL=true is load-bearing: the commodity-macro scoreboard NEUTRALIZES this chain's momentum and percentile legs so gold's own price action can never score it (CLAUDE.md gold momentum-loop guard). It ranks on miners-confirmation, the Dalio tilt and the regime read instead. Silver-primary names beta against fmp_symbol_secondary when the chain map stamps dominant_metal=silver.

chains.name: Rare earths & strategic metals
chains.thesis: Export controls turned rare earths, antimony, gallium and tungsten from commodities into strategic chokepoints; Western governments now act as forced buyers (price floors, DoD/DOE awards, stockpiles), repricing every ex-China ounce on policy datelines rather than spot.

commodity.spot_source: web-cited (Shanghai Metals Market NdPr via press) — NdPr is NOT an FMP commodity

chains.notes: The policy chain: most catalysts are government datelines, not price. 'Other Precious Metals & Mining' and 'Specialty Chemicals' are (verify) — Specialty Chemicals is included ONLY to catch processors/separators FMP files there; the chain map must drop actual chemical companies (chain_fit_confidence=low). UUUU carries uranium_fuel_cycle AND this chain (counts toward both caps).

chains.name: Diversified mining majors
chains.thesis: The BHP/RIO class is the cash-returning, low-cost-quartile backbone of the basket: multi-commodity books that survive any single metal's downcycle and fund the next one from operating cash. The read here is capital discipline against the capex cycle — who is building at the top — not any one commodity price.

commodity.spot_source: no single spot — a diversified book has no one price. commodity_beta_2y runs against proxy_etf XME (feed-verified); the per-name commodity_revenue_share from the chain map carries the actual mix

chains.notes: PROVEN live 2026-07-27: 'Industrial Materials' (BHP/RIO/TECK), 'Steel' (VALE). The spec's proposed 'Other Industrial Metals & Mining' DOES NOT EXIST in FMP's vocabulary — it would have screened 0 rows silently, the exact v1.0 failure mode. 'Steel' is a COARSE net: it also returns scrap-based converters (NUE/STLD/X-class) that mine NOTHING. The chain map MUST drop them — the physical anchor has to be EXTRACTION (an owned orebody/mine), not conversion or fabrication; a converter is chain_fit_confidence=low, printed and dropped. commodity_revenue_share is REQUIRED from the chain map for every name here and must NEVER default to 1.0 — a diversified book's torque is its actual mix.

vocab_note: fmp_industries are EXACT strings from FMP /stable/available-industries — verified live 2026-07-27 against real company profiles, not guessed. Any string listed in a chain's fmp_industries_verify is NOT yet proven to return members: 0 rows there prints a WARN and the build continues; 0 rows on a PROVEN string STOPs (the anti-shrink guard). Once a live run confirms a string, delete it from fmp_industries_verify — config edit only, never code.
torque_note: torque_metrics=false chains (equipment/tech/service cohorts) get the non-commodity metric set — gm_trajectory / rev_yoy / fcf_margin / ndebt_ebitda — and NEVER fcf_torque_10pct: there is no spot price for their output to be levered to, so a torque number would be fabricated precision. Commodity chains without an FMP spot symbol still get commodity_beta_2y against their proxy_etf.
split_note: SPLIT RULE (FUTURE_RESOURCES_SPLIT_SPEC §3): business_model producer|royalty_streamer -> this book; equipment_services|utility -> fdt; developer -> the book owning the physical asset being developed (a copper-mine developer here, an SMR developer in fdt). royalty_streamer is a legal business_model ONLY in this book. Cross-book dual membership is FORBIDDEN — basket-dedup resolves straddlers by producer revenue share, ties to Mining, and the publish-time backstop STOPs on any intersection with the fdt payload.
